nt: Piegāde tikai uz adresi, par maksu
dh:
Hot stapler with battery power (lithium).
An easy-to-use tool for quick and efficient repairs.
Strongly and permanently repairs breaks, cracks and tears in rigid or flexible plastic parts.
It is well suited for repairing plastic parts, for example repairing car parts.

The set includes:
- Stapler
- Carrying case
- Flat staples 0.6 mm x 50 pcs
- Flat staples 0.8 mm x 50 pcs
- Inside corner staples 0.6 mm x 50 pcs
- 230V charger.
